question: Indian opener Murali Vijay announced his retirement from international cricket in______
solution:
The correct answer is __**January 2023.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Murali Vijay, the Indian cricketer, announced his retirement from international cricket on **January 1, 2023**.
 
• Murali Vijay was known for his performances as an **opener** in the Indian cricket team.
 
• He made his debut in international cricket in **2008** and played his last Test match in **2018**.
 
• Vijay was particularly successful in Test cricket, scoring over **3,900 runs** in 61 matches, including 12 centuries.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Test Cricket Achievements**

 
 
• Murali Vijay scored **12 centuries** and 15 half-centuries in Test cricket.
 
• He was part of the Indian team that reached the number one spot in ICC Test rankings.
 
• Vijay's highest score in Test cricket is **167 runs**.
 
 
 
• **IPL Career**
 
 
• Murali Vijay played for several franchises in the Indian Premier League (IPL), including Chennai Super Kings and Kings XI Punjab.
 
• He was known for his aggressive batting style in T20 cricket.
 
• Vijay scored over **2,600 runs** in the IPL, including two centuries.
 
 
 
• **Domestic Cricket**
 
 
• Vijay represented Tamil Nadu in domestic cricket.
 
• He was a consistent performer in the Ranji Trophy, India's premier domestic competition.
 
• His performances in domestic cricket earned him a spot in the national team.
